title: UnecePortMovementEvent
description: A movement of a vessel during a port call.

actualOccurrenceDateTime.description: An actual date, time, date time, or other date time value of the occurrence of this port movement event.

arrivalRelatedLocation.description: An arrival location related to this port movement event.

description.description: A textual description of this port movement event.

estimatedOccurrenceDateTime.description: An estimated date, time, date time, or other date time value of the occurrence of this port movement event.

identifier.description: An identifier for this port movement event.

maritimeAnchorageIndicator.description: The indication of whether or not this port movement event involves a maritime anchorage.

pilotBoardingPlace.description: A pilot boarding place, expressed as text, for this port movement event.

requestedOccurrenceDateTime.description: A requested date, time, date time, or other date time value of the occurrence of this port movement event.

scheduledOccurrenceDateTime.description: A scheduled date, time, date time, or other date time value of the occurrence of this port movement event.

sequenceNumeric.description: The sequence number for this port movement event.

typeCode.description: A code specifying a type of port movement event.
